statements.label: A
statements.sql: SELECT season, tournament_id, competition_type, created_at FROM season_tournaments ORDER BY season, tournament_id

statements.label: B
statements.sql: SELECT match_id, club_id, season, tournament_id, round, weather, wx_coef, forecast_by, created_at FROM match_weather WHERE season >= 9 ORDER BY season, tournament_id, round, match_id

statements.label: C
statements.sql: SELECT match_id, club_id, season, window_seq, weather, attendance, ticket, commercial, broadcast, created_at FROM match_attendance WHERE season >= 9 ORDER BY season, window_seq, match_id

statements.label: D
statements.sql: SELECT club_id, capacity, tier, shell_influence, bonus_points, fans, next_attendance_mod, next_weather, fans_window_start FROM stadiums ORDER BY club_id

statements.label: E
statements.sql: SELECT club_id, facility_key, level FROM club_facilities WHERE facility_key IN ('commercial', 'broadcast') ORDER BY club_id, facility_key

statements.label: F
statements.sql: SELECT club_id, balance, updated_at FROM ledger_accounts ORDER BY club_id

statements.label: G
statements.sql: SELECT id, club_id, kind, amount, balance_after, ref_type, ref_id, memo, created_at FROM ledger_entries WHERE (kind = 'revenue' AND ref_type = 'match') OR (kind = 'prize' AND ref_type IN ('match_home', 'match_away', 'match_home_fix', 'match_away_fix')) OR ref_type IN ('wo_rollback_prize', 'wo_rollback_revenue') ORDER BY id
